verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents per-framework control mapping across its supported frameworks (secureframe-docs-60), including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA (secureframe-docs-40, secureframe-docs-42, secureframe-docs-43). It also says it automatically maps existing controls to CMMC requirements to identify gaps (secureframe-docs-73), which implies some reuse of existing controls toward another framework. secureframe-docs-82 repeats that same CMMC statement and adds no new fact, so it does not raise the grade, and the reviewer's concern is valid. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that SOC 2 controls and evidence automatically count toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA; a view showing the cross-framework overlap; any independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-framework reuse.
